raw_dob: Request-memory only; derived 18+ outcome/evaluation/policy/evidence persists. No DOB column/log/event/browser storage.
password: Request-memory then operation-specific Data Protection protected framework hash; canonical password remains null until that operation proof wins. No plaintext password storage.
proof: Cryptographically random numeric policy-length code, separately protected code and digest; scoped intended delivery only; no HTTP/outbox/log exposure.
pending_address: Normalized lookup email plus separately protected delivery address; explicit approved pending-material retention; clear on success or bounded policy purge.
caller: Protected random browser context; SHA256 browser digest; HMAC real-peer partition with server-owned key; expiring rate buckets. No raw IP persistence.
references: Versioned notices, policy/processing/retention approvals, safe idempotency results and correlation/state/outbox references remain accountable evidence.
legal_boundary: No legal basis, consent category, retention duration, jurisdiction or production publication is invented. Approved effective references are mandatory server inputs.
operations_owner: TUN-P2-016 integrates governed delivery consumers, audit and maintenance scheduling; TUN-P2-005 owns sign-in/session policy.
test_data: Disposable PostgreSQL, fixture-only emails/DOBs/passwords/publications/policies. No real user data processed.
